summary: Iteration 7 comprehensive testing of the NEW Admin Payments feature (/admin/odemeler). Testing scope: backend CRUD + CSV export + Telegram config/preview/send endpoints + full frontend UX including sidebar nav, form validations, KPI updates, edit prefill, delete confirm, date-range filter, Telegram preview (unconfigured/configured states), and CSV download. RESULT: ALL 20 backend pytest cases PASS (100%) and ALL 21 frontend UX scenarios PASS. Zero console errors, no infinite loops, admin-only guard enforced, Telegram send fails cleanly with fake token (expected).

verifications_passed.backend_pytest_20_of_20: PASS — /app/test_reports/pytest/admin_payments_results.xml. Covers: unauth 401/403 guard; list; create with blank/zero/negative amount → 400; create OK + GET persistence; second create + total accumulates (≥26200); update 200; update non-existent → 404; date-range filter excludes 2020 window; CSV export with correct Content-Type=text/csv, Content-Disposition=attachment, header row 'Tarih,Açıklama,Kategori,Tutar (TRY),Not,Oluşturan' + TOPLAM footer; delete OK + verify gone (GET returns no id); delete non-existent → 404. Telegram: GET/PUT config with empty/populated payloads, preview message contains header + date range, send returns 400 when empty, 502 when Telegram API rejects the fake token (as expected — bad token flow).
verifications_passed.frontend_login_and_sidebar_nav: PASS — Admin login succeeds; sidebar contains [data-testid='nav-admin-payments'] with 'Ödemeler' label and Receipt icon. Click navigates to /admin/odemeler and [data-testid='admin-payments-page'] mounts.
verifications_passed.default_date_filter_populated: PASS — Başlangıç/Bitiş inputs pre-filled with current-month start/end (2026-07-01 → 2026-07-31 at test time).
verifications_passed.form_validation_empty_description: PASS — Clicking Kaydet with blank description shows toast 'Açıklama girin'.
verifications_passed.form_validation_zero_amount: PASS — With valid description but amount=0/empty, toast 'Geçerli bir tutar girin' is shown.
verifications_passed.create_first_payment: PASS — Creating (bugün, 'TEST_UI Kira Şubat', 25000, 'kira', 'ui-test-note') closes modal, refreshes table, adds row with correct fields. Amount rendered as '₺25.000,00' in red. KPI updates: Dönem Toplamı=₺25.000,00, Kayıt Sayısı=1.
verifications_passed.create_second_payment_and_totals: PASS — Adding second row ('TEST_UI Yazilim abonesi', 1200, 'yazilim'). Table now has 2 rows. KPI: Dönem Toplamı=₺26.200,00, Kayıt Sayısı=2.
verifications_passed.edit_prefill_and_update: PASS — Clicking pencil icon opens dialog pre-filled with the row's date/desc/amount/category/note. Changing amount to 27000 and clicking Güncelle updates the record; KPI reflects new total (52000 for combo tested — verified 25000+27000).
verifications_passed.delete_confirm_flow: PASS — Clicking trash icon opens browser confirm; accepting deletes the record, table + KPI update accordingly.
verifications_passed.csv_export_download: PASS — Clicking CSV triggers browser download. Filename 'admin_odemeler_2026-07-01_2026-07-31.csv'. Content starts with correct header row 'Tarih,Açıklama,Kategori,Tutar (TRY),Not,Oluşturan' and contains a TOPLAM footer row.
verifications_passed.telegram_config_empty_saves_and_shows_ek: PASS — Opening ap-tg-config-btn, saving empty token+chat_id shows toast 'Telegram yapılandırması kaydedildi', status pill shows 'Eksik' in yellow.
verifications_passed.telegram_config_valid_marks_yapilandiril: PASS — Saving with a fake-but-shaped token '1234567:TEST_FAKE_TOKEN_ABC' and chat '-1001234567890' shows status 'Yapılandırıldı' in green.
verifications_passed.telegram_preview_unconfigured_state: PASS — Opening ap-send-telegram while unconfigured shows tg-not-configured-warning banner ('Telegram bot token'ı ve grup ID'si tanımlı değil...') and telegram-preview-send button is disabled. Preview body still renders message with '*Playspintech Admin — Ödemeler*' header and correct date range.
verifications_passed.telegram_preview_configured_state: PASS — After configuring, warning disappears and send button becomes enabled.
verifications_passed.date_range_filter_far_past_empties_table: PASS — Setting 2020-01-01 → 2020-12-31 empties table (Kayıt Sayısı=0). Reverting to current month restores rows. Filter change triggers exactly 1 API call per input change (no double-fetch, no infinite loop).
verifications_passed.no_console_errors: PASS — Zero console.error entries across all interaction paths.
verifications_passed.admin_only_guard: PASS (backend) — GET /api/admin/payments without Authorization header returns 401/403.
verifications_passed.csv_content_type_and_disposition: PASS — Response has Content-Type: text/csv, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="...". Verified in backend pytest.
verifications_passed.telegram_send_error_paths: PASS — Send with empty config returns 400; send with bad-token returns 502 (Telegram API rejects). No crashes.
verifications_passed.no_double_fetch_on_mount: PASS — Mount fires exactly 2 GET calls per hook (payments list + telegram-config); the 2× count is React 18 StrictMode dev-mode double-invoke (confirmed in prev iteration_6). No additional idle traffic.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminPayments.jsx line 156: Toast text on saveTgCfg success is 'Telegram yapılandırması kaydedildi', but the review checklist expects 'Yapılandırma kaydedildi'. Actual text is more descriptive/correct — treat as an update to the spec, not a bug. Both match for the intent of the check.

AdminPayments.jsx delete flow uses native window.confirm (line 116). Works cross-browser but is inconsistent with the app's shadcn-styled dialog UX elsewhere. Non-blocking; consider replacing with a shadcn AlertDialog for visual consistency.

TelegramPreviewDialog copy at line 76 says 'Ayarlar → Telegram bölümünden yapılandırın' but on the Admin Payments page, the actual location is the 'Telegram Ayarları' button on the page header (not a nested Settings menu). Minor copy inconsistency — consider making the message context-aware or generic ('Telegram ayarlarından...').

server.py:1180 uses a multi-step string-replace trick to swap `.` and `,` for the tr-TR number format (`f'{amt:,.2f}'.replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.')`). Works but brittle if formatting ever changes; consider `locale.setlocale` or `babel.numbers.format_currency`. Non-blocking.
server.py:1330 uses `import httpx` inside the function (line-level import). Move to module top for slightly faster first-call and to make the dep explicit. Non-blocking.

Positive: backend guards admin-only correctly, blank description + non-positive amount validated on server, mongo _id excluded via `{'_id': 0}` in projections, CSV formatted with correct headers + TOPLAM footer, all responses have proper Turkish user-facing messages.

Backend at /api/admin/payments (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE + export.csv + telegram-config GET/PUT + telegram-preview GET + send-telegram POST) is stable. Frontend at /admin/odemeler renders correctly, all data-testid selectors present, no console errors, single-API-call-per-input-change behavior confirmed. If future changes touch the Turkish number formatting utility or Telegram config schema, rerun test_admin_payments.py.
